# dsh-zoom
Global UI zoom for the DeepSeek Harness web client: scales the **whole interface** — sidebar, menus,
settings, overlays and conversation — from the keyboard.
> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or published by DeepSeek.
## Why this exists
DeepSeek Harness ships one typography setting, `ui-theme.fontSize`, which affects **conversation bod
y text only**. Sidebar labels, menus and settings chrome are fixed pixel sizes, and the app has no p
age zoom: its menu has no View/zoom roles and its code exposes no `setZoomLevel`/`zoomFactor`. So `C
md` + `=` does nothing out of the box. This plugin adds that.

install finishes. (An npm release may follow; that would make the shorter `dsh-zoom` spec work too.)

A restart is the guaranteed way to activate it; profiles with HMR usually recompose on their own.
## Shortcuts
| Shortcut | Action |

| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `=` (also `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `Shift` + `=`, i.e. `+`) | zoom in one step |
| `Cmd`/`Ctr

l` + `-` | zoom out one step |
| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `0` | back to 100% |
Steps: 80 · 90 · 100 · 110 · 125 · 150 · 175 · 200 %. The level is persisted in `localStorage` (`dsh
-zoom:level`) and restored on the next launch. For scripting or debugging, the page exposes `__dshZo
om.get()`, `__dshZoom.set(1.25)`, `__dshZoom.step(±1)` and `__dshZoom.reset()`.
## How it works
- The zoom is `document.documentElement.style.zoom` — the standardised Chromium CSS `zoom` property.
It must live on the **root element**: zooming a wrapper instead collapses the app frame (`#root` me

asures 0 height) and introduces a horizontal scrollbar.
- Because CSS zoom does not rescale viewport
units, the plugin also injects a small `!important` patch for the few surviving `max-height: calc(1
00vh …)` / `100dvh` overlay clamps (menu scroll region, risk-confirmation dialog, toast, image light
box). Those rules are addressed by hashed class names, so each is applied **only if it exists** in t

he running build; on any other build the patch is simply empty and the core zoom is unaffected.
- Th
e shortcuts are a window **capture**-phase `keydown` listener. The shell dispatches its own shortcut
s on `document` in the capture phase, so a window listener runs first; the chord is consumed with `p
reventDefault` + `stopImmediatePropagation` before editors, the terminal or the composer can see it.
- Persistence uses `localStorage`, which is real and durable on the desktop shell's `dsh-app://app`
origin (registered `standard` + `secure`, default session, no CSP).
## Known limitations
- Canvas-backed surfaces (xterm terminal, Monaco editors, PDF/spreadsheet previews) rasterize at the
unzoomed size and look slightly soft at higher factors. Each change dispatches a `resize` so they r

e-measure.
- The shortcuts do not fire while focus is inside a sidebar browser/preview `<webview>` o

r iframe — click the main window first.
- macOS traffic lights are positioned in window points and d

o not scale. Above 125 % check the top strip and the window drag region.
- In a plain **browser** (n
ot the desktop shell), `Cmd` + `=` is the browser's own zoom; this plugin calls `preventDefault`, so

the page zoom is replaced by the plugin's CSS zoom.
- The app ships `immediately: true` prefetching
, so the module loads at boot; plugins like this one cannot react to a build that renames every hash
ed class without a release.
## Compatibility
Tested against DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** (Electron 44 / Chromium 152) on macOS. It declares no
`@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency on purpose: the host half is an empty `apply()` and the browser
half uses only standard DOM APIs, so there is nothing to version-gate. The viewport-unit patch is t
he only build-specific part and degrades to a no-op.

# dsh-zoom（中文）
DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的**整体界面缩放**插件：侧栏、菜单、设置、浮层、对话一起放大，用快捷键控制。
> 非官方社区插件，与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系。
## 为什么需要它
DSH 只提供一个排版设置 `ui-theme.fontSize`，而且**只影响对话正文**；侧栏、菜单、设置页都是固定像素，应用本身也没有页面缩放（菜单里没有 View/缩放角色，代码里没有 `s
etZoomLevel`/`zoomFactor`），所以 `Cmd` + `=` 默认没有任何反应。
## 安装
应用内：侧栏 **插件 → Add plugin**，填 `github:DC-507/dsh-zoom`，装完点 **Enable now**。命令行同样可以：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| 快捷键 | 动作 |

| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `=`（或 `Cmd`+`Shift`+`=`） | 放大一档 |
| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `-` | 缩小一档 |
| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `0

` + `=`（或 `Cmd`+`Shift`+`=`） | 放大一档 |
| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `-` | 缩小一档 |
| `Cmd`/`Ctrl` + `0` | 回到 100% |
## 实现要点
[该节后续省略]
## 已知限制
画布类面板（终端、Monaco、PDF/表格预览）高倍率下略糊；焦点在侧栏 `<webview>`/iframe 里时快捷键不生效；macOS 红绿灯不参与缩放，125% 以上请留意顶栏拖拽区；在普通
F/表格预览）高倍率下略糊；焦点在侧栏 `<webview>`/iframe 里时快捷键不生效；macOS 红绿灯不参与缩放，125% 以上请留意顶栏拖拽区；在普通浏览器里会顶掉浏览器自带的页面缩放。
## 许可证
MIT，见 LICENSE。
